subject: Post-demo: Proofpoint POC — custodians, timelines & next actions
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@clearsky.ai>, Lena Moore <lena.moore@atlasretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: Proofpoint POC — custodians, timelines & next actions

Hi Lena & Amit,

Thanks again for your time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the POC timeline: 

Call highlights (short):
- Goal: validate Redwood inference latency at 99th perc for batch inference and streaming scenario for search/assistant flows.
- Success metrics: 99th percentile < 220ms (1k token avg), embedding throughput 2k req/min, no data egress beyond VPC.
- Primary constraints: Atlas needs KMS integration and SOC-2 evidence; infra isolation required for any dedicated test.

Proposed POC plan (2 weeks):
1) Week 1 — infra handover & smoke tests (infra steward)
2) Week 2 — workload replay + quality check (app steward)
3) Runbook & signoff (security + procurement checkpoints)

Custodian suggestions (steward model):
- Infrastructure steward: Ben Carter (redwood) — config, dedicated pool, autoscale policy
- Application steward: Atlas dev lead (Lena) — traffic patterns, replay corpus, acceptance prompts
- Security steward: Priyom Das (redwood) — KMS/HSM proposal, audit log retention
- Procurement contact: Amit Shah (Clearsky) / Atlas procurement (cc'ed) — license & SOW timelines

Attached: initial POC scope (PDF) and a lightweight procurement checklist (Excel).

Ask: please confirm the custodians above or propose alternates, and confirm availability for a 30-min infra handover on Friday (Nov 20) 10:00 PT.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: proofpoint-poc-scope-v1.pdf (2 pages), procurement-checklist-atlas.xlsx (stub)

From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@clearsky.ai>

Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Proofpoint POC — custodians, timelines & next actions

Vanessa — thanks for the concise plan. A couple quick clarifications from Atlas procurement: 
- They need to confirm if a short-term NDA addendum is required for log retention during the POC. I can loop procurement but need the list of data types we will collect.
- SOW: we prefer a 2-week fixed engagement with clear exit criteria (measurement script + acceptance thresholds).

We'd be OK with the steward assignments; Lena will confirm the app lead. Friday 10:00 PT works for me.

Amit
VP, Cloud Ops (Clearsky)
amit.shah@clearsky.ai

Picking up action on infra handover and a couple technical notes: 
- I will own the dedicated pool provisioning and the initial perf smoke (infra steward).
- Need Atlas to provide a representative replay corpus (500–1k records) and expected concurrency shape for the two scenarios (search vs assistant).
- KMS: we support AWS KMS and customer-managed keys; if Atlas is on GCP/Azure, we can map to their KMS but will need a short network checklist (VPC peering / private endpoints).

Proposed infra checklist (for Friday):
- credentials & access matrix (IAM/service accounts)
- VPC endpoint IP ranges + firewall exception list
- test dataset location (S3/GCS) + sample TTL

I’ll prepare the smoke-test script and share a link to the perf dashboard after Friday.

Ben

Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — quick confirmation and next steps: 
- Custodian roster confirmed: Infra = Ben (redwood), App = Lena (Atlas), Security = Priyom (redwood), Procurement = Amit (Clearsky/Atlas collab).
- Friday 11/20 10:00 PT infra handover confirmed (calendar invite sent).
- Priyom: will review and publish the short SOW by EOD (we have a tentative DocuSign link).
- Ben: please drop the smoke-test script link and early dashboard before the call so Atlas can review the metrics we will collect.

Acceptance / success criteria (finalized):
- Performance: 99th < 220ms for streaming/1k tokens and embedding throughput >= 2k req/min under the expected concurrency window.
- Security: no plaintext logs outside customer-controlled storage; KMS keys customer-managed with rotation policy documented.
- Operational: runbook for failover + a single run of the replay test with results uploaded to the shared drive.

I'll take owner action to track signoff and capture any deviations in the hubspot deal record. Thanks — looking forward to the handover.

-Vanessa
Senior Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference
